summary_text:
LEGAL SUMMARY:

The case is listed in the court of the Junior Civil Judge at Chennur, Telangana. The court is presided over by Sri G. Uday Bhaskar Rao, Junior Civil Judge, Chennur, PRC. The matter involves a criminal proceeding between the State of Telangana, represented by the Sub-Inspector of Police, Chennur, and the accused Jangili Ganganna and 13 others. 

A docket order was issued on 07.03.2018 (O.M. Dis. No. 1051/2018/crl) by the Hon’ble District and Sessions Judge, Adilabad, permitting the entry of the case in the LPC (Local Police Court) Register. 

The case was recorded under the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1998, and the order was given under the seal of the court on the 13th day of March, 2018. 

No other facts, such as specific charges, dates of incidents, or names of individuals beyond those in the evidence, are provided. 

[Not Available in Evidence]:  
- Specific nature of the offense  
- Date of filing of the complaint  
- Details of the accused other than Jangili Ganganna and 13 others  
- Jurisdictional basis of the case beyond the court and order  
- Any statutory section beyond No. 46 of 1998  
- The identity of the complainant beyond "State of Telangana Rep. by SHO, Chennur"  

The legal outcome or disposition of the case is not specified in the evidence.  

This summary is strictly based on the provided evidence and does not include any inference, assumption, or external fact.
